Whitney leans over the menu and grins. "I'll have a double with everything," she tells the waiter.

A few minutes later, Whitney's meal arrives... a massive double burger stacked high, beside a mountain of fries. She picks it up in both paws and takes a bite, eyes closing happily. Soon she devours the burger and starts in on the fries.

You order your meal—a single cheeseburger with fries—and the waiter nods.
